overview.title: Tasks overview
overview.subtitle: See what is running, what needs you, and where to inspect details.

asks.title: Answer pending questions
asks.detail: Agents are waiting for human input before they continue.

outboxStuck.title: Retry stuck deliveries
outboxStuck.detail: One or more IM messages stopped retrying and need inspection.

jobs.title: Watch running work
jobs.detail: Jobs are currently pending or running.

outbox.title: Watch message delivery
outbox.detail: Outbound IM messages are still moving through the queue.

automation.title: Review automation
automation.detail: Schedules, heartbeats, or active goals are running in the background.

idle.title: No active task pressure
idle.detail: Open Jobs when you want to inspect recent agent runs.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.subtitle: Long-running agent invocations and their results.

empty.title: No jobs yet
empty.description: Jobs are created when an agent runs in async mode — via `agim --invoke` or an inline /run command from chat.

batch.confirmCancelDesc: Running jobs will be sent a stop signal. Already-completed jobs are unaffected.
batch.confirmRerunDesc: New jobs will be created from the original prompts.

subtasks.title: Subtasks
subtasks.subtitle: Per-conversation child tasks spawned by the parent agent.

empty.title: No subtasks yet
empty.description: Subtasks appear when an agent dispatches work to another agent inside a chat thread.

bgjobs.title: Background jobs
bgjobs.subtitle: Long-running work started via ~/.agim/scripts/bgjob. All agents share ~/.agim/bgjobs/. Click a row for command and log tail.

empty.title: No background jobs
empty.description: Jobs appear after an agent runs ~/.agim/scripts/bgjob start <name> -- <cmd>. Data lands in ~/.agim/bgjobs/; older Claude / opencode / Codex trees stay readable.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.subtitle: Cron-style triggers that re-invoke an agent with a fixed prompt.

empty.title: No schedules configured
empty.description: Create a schedule from the agent's chat via `/cron set` or by running `agim cron create` in the CLI.

outbox.title: Outbox
outbox.subtitle: Pending IM-platform deliveries. The crash-safe queue retries on transient failures and parks unrecoverable ones in `giving_up`.

empty.title: Outbox is empty
empty.description: Messages move through the queue and are deleted on successful delivery. A non-empty outbox here means the queue is actively flushing or a delivery is stuck.

action.confirmRetryDesc: The row's status flips back to pending and the sender will attempt delivery again on the next tick.

a2a.title: Agent ↔ Agent
a2a.subtitle: Recent inline jobs spawned with a parent (one agent invoking another).

empty.title: No agent-to-agent calls yet
empty.description: Inline a2a calls appear here once an agent uses the `agim --invoke` tool with a parent context.

heartbeat.title: Heartbeat bindings
heartbeat.subtitle: Cross-thread view of every /heartbeat bind. Enable/disable a binding from here; create new ones from inside the IM thread itself (/heartbeat bind <body>).
heartbeat.empty: No heartbeat bindings yet. Run /heartbeat bind <body> in any IM thread to create one.

goals.title: Active goals
goals.subtitle: Cross-thread view of every active /goal. Lifecycle controls (pause / complete / cancel) operate without the IM thread; creating a new goal still requires the thread context — /goal set <title>.
goals.empty: No active goals. Create one inside any IM thread with /goal set <title>.

asks.title: Pending ask_user
asks.subtitle: Live list of every mcp__agim__ask_user waiting on a reply. Cancelling here gives the agent the same response shape as a natural timeout (ok: false, reason: 'cancelled').

plans.title: Plan history
plans.subtitle: Audit log of plan-mode exit handshakes, including outcomes and proposed plan text.
plans.emptyFiltered: No plan history for this thread key.
